decisions.series: One series 1-529, one base completion checklist.
decisions.trueRookies: Only the 10 card numbers verified in TCDB rookie index receive RC on Base.
decisions.gold: Distinct 529-card Gold checklist. Gold #525-528 are different players replacing four Base checklists. NEVER derive Gold from Base.
decisions.goldOdds: 1 Gold card per ordinary wax pack; 1:1 ProductSet odds.
decisions.factoryOnly: Base and Gold #529 are late factory-only cards. Included for checklist completion, but current VCS set-level odds cannot exclude #529 from pack pools. Release BLOCKED until per-card pack eligibility exclusion is implemented and tested.
decisions.subsets: Clean UER and other notes from player names. Keep printed subset abbreviations as subset metadata.
decisions.packs: VCS four cards per pack, 24 packs per box. Original standard physical pack held 14 base plus one Gold.
decisions.release: Unreleased until #529 factory-only handling, images, pricing, pack artwork and QA complete.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 529 complete Base cards; #529 factory-only, must be excluded from wax pack draws before release.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: 1 Gold per wax pack. Actual separate checklist; #525–528 feature replacement players. #529 factory-only.
